guarantees.claim: The constant array holds the standard AES forward S-Box substitution values, with linear index i providing the 8-bit substitution output for input i.
guarantees.cond: always (for any read access to this LUT)

uncertain_points.claim: The chunk provides only the S-Box data; the actual lookup implementation (addressing logic, output latching, possible masking) is located elsewhere and could introduce functional errors or timing side-channel leakage if not designed correctly.
uncertain_points.risk: Incorrect AES substitution or secret-dependent power/EM signature if the lookup is not properly registered or glitch‑free.
